stroke.note: Tip heights are shoulder-relative, derived from the existing side-view figure measurements. 0.28 m is reported for one bird at 12 m/s. Phase fraction is inferred from wake wavelengths; it is not a measured 3D joint time series.

confidence.strokeEndpoints: species-specific figure measurements and reported amplitude
confidence.upstroke: estimated; robin span proxy and starling joint-sequence prior
confidence.glide: flight-photo fits; dihedral and tail spread estimated
confidence.bound: Tobalske 1995 observed glide/partial-bound/bound at 8–18 m/s; speed trend supported, probability and duration estimated
confidence.transitions: bounded smooth interpolation; not captured motion
confidence.gaitSchedule: Rayner 2001 Table 1 mean bout timings, one tunnel bird; interpolation and variation estimated
confidence.phase: Independent phases are a modeling default; no direct wild-starling phase-locking evidence found

intermittentFlight.table: Table 1, printed page 197, bird 19; wind tunnel, one individual
intermittentFlight.limitations: Linear speed interpolation, individual variation, bound probabilities and alarm response are simulation choices. Reported mean duty factors need not equal the ratio of mean bout durations. No natural murmuration phase measurements. Continuous flapping at 6.2 m/s; intermittent above about 7.5 m/s in this tunnel.

confidence.stoop_tuck: Ponitz figure width/length target; experiment reached 22.5 m/s, not maximum-speed tuck
confidence.stoop_m: photo and CAD landmarks; front-view hand droop remains approximate
confidence.pullout_early: Selim figure target; existing pose has residual landmark error
confidence.flap: mixed peregrine amplitude and generic upstroke estimates
